summary: Aptose Biosciences Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition by Hanmi Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd. and its subsidiary HS North America Ltd. via a statutory plan of arrangement under Alberta law. Hanmi Purchaser acquired all outstanding common shares not already owned by Hanmi for C$2.41 per share in cash, totaling approximately USD$3.47 million for 2,043,719 shares. Hanmi owned 19.93% of shares prior to closing. The arrangement was approved by the Court of King's Bench of Alberta on March 31, 2026. The Special Committee of Aptose's board was advised by Locust Walk Securities, LLC. The acquisition is now closed; no further regulatory or shareholder action remains.
